description:
§15.10.1 (S459 round 6, F1) — a `${}` nested INSIDE lifted markup declares into that markup's scope: after `${ let n = 0 }` inside `lift
…
`, the later sibling handlers write and read the LOCAL `n`, not the `bind n` prop. The parent cell `@v` stays 7. Before round 6 the nested block started a fresh empty scope and the handler wrote `@v` = 9, silently.
rationale: §15.10.1: "From the point of declaration onward in the same scope, the local binding shadows the prop." §15.11.1: "A local declaration, parameter or loop binder named like the prop is not the prop … and is writable."
